question: Which of the following compounds is most responsible for the maintenance of appropriate coronary blood flow?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Nitric oxide -> vasodilation of coronary blood vessels -> maintenance of appropriate coronary blood flow -> 95% CHAIN: VEGF -> promotes angiogenesis -> increased blood vessel formation in the coronary circulation -> maintenance of appropriate coronary blood flow -> 95%
analysis: Nitric oxide is the compound most responsible for the maintenance of appropriate coronary blood flow as it acts as a potent vasodilator in the coronary arteries.
